correctness.rationale: Conjugation by a vertex permutation is a signed edge-coordinate isometry preserving the cut space. The averaged projection still fixes every cut vector and has range in that space, so it suffices to minimize over the invariant family. An elementary stabilizer check also verifies the reduction at m=2 or n=2: a clique-edge column i,j is odd under the transposition of its ends, so its potential is a(e_i-e_j); a cross-edge column i,u has clique potential b(e_i-1_A/m), and a potential on B that is constant off u. Fixing class-constant gradients and the B-mean-zero gradients sets that B potential to -e_u/m. Fixing A-mean-zero gradients leaves just ma+nb=1. The frozen Q_t exhausts these columns with a=(m+nt)/(mN), b=(1-t)/N. The clique column sum is 2(N-1)|a|; the cross column sum is the one in the proof, whose last two absolute terms have a constant signed sum mN in its common denominator. Thus, with K=(m-1)(m+2n-2), on [0,1] the two norms are 2(N-1)(m+nt)/(mN) and 1+K(1-t)/(mN). They cross at t_*=(m-2)(n-1)/D, D=2n(N-1)+K. The first norm for t>1 and the second norm for t<0 cannot improve the crossing. Substitution gives the stated minimum, and at t=0 the cross norm is maximal, with excess K t_* /(mN). This excess is zero exactly at m=2, and taking leading terms on the diagonal gives the three limits.
residual_risks: The proof is in real unweighted edge-l1 and does not classify all non-invariant minimizers or minimize the complementary cycle projection.

value.rationale: The mathematical question itself is worthwhile: an exact gap on an infinite natural graph family would quantify when the canonical cut projection fails to minimize the edge-l1 norm. But that gap and the full optimality characterization are already recoverable from the verified exact coverage. The frozen calculation uses the same two column orbits and one-parameter optimization as the encompassing cut theorem. No further structural phenomenon, parameter range, or meaningfully different method is left; the diagonal limits are immediate consequences of the covered formulas. The rejection is of the added scientific contribution of this record, not of the usefulness of the invariant.
residual_risks: Verified earlier provenance could change how the usefulness of the original contribution is credited. There is no substantive surviving new claim to repair on the present evidence.
